title: [Shopify] Fix shop card transaction navigation
summary: The Shopify Shop Card payment transaction navigation now opens the correct transaction list and filters by the Shop field instead of the obsolete Shop Code FlowField.
key_points: Payment Transactions action now opens the Shopify order transaction list instead of the balance-transaction page
Filtering changed from the obsolete Shop Code FlowField to the Shop field
Test coverage updated to create order transactions and verify the Shop filter
